text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with number y.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Plate(x) ::: x is a license plate.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
∀x (Plate(x) → (BeginsWith(x, 34) → FromIstanbul(x))) ::: All plates starting with 34 are from Istanbul.
∀x (¬BeginsWith(x, 34) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not starting with 34 are not from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(Joe) ::: Joe's vehicle plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(Tom'sPlate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.

Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(Tom'sPlate) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
